description: This file implements the methods of the CookieInclusionStatus class, which manages cookie inclusion/exclusion reasons and warnings, including logic for handling downgrade warnings, debug string generation, and testing utilities.

classes.name: CookieInclusionStatus
classes.description: A class representing the inclusion/exclusion status of cookies, including reasons for exclusion, warnings, and related logic.

methods.description: Default constructor for CookieInclusionStatus.

methods.description: Constructor initializing with a specific exclusion reason.

methods.description: Constructor initializing with an exclusion reason and a warning reason.

methods.name: CookieInclusionStatus(WarningReason warning)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a warning reason.

methods.description: Equality comparison operator for CookieInclusionStatus.

methods.description: Inequality comparison operator for CookieInclusionStatus.
